desc:
Originally developed for Lockheed & NASA, this lubrication technology bonds with metal at the molecular level for long lasting superior lubrication. The bond is made stronger with heat and pressure, making it ideal for full-auto firearm use.

Only lubrication technology that is Space Certified and in the Space Hall of Fame. Currently being field tested by US and allied forces.

All-in-One cleaning, protection, and lubrication.

4oz Full size bottle

Comes with free 10ml bottle, perfect to keep in a range bag or take along for your next hunting trip

-Microscopic Pore Impregnation: Rather than just sitting on top of the metal like standard gun oils, Vril is designed to treat the metal itself. It penetrates and fills the microscopic metal pores (roughly 3 to 5 microns in size). By smoothing out these microscopic imperfections, it offers advanced protection of moving parts like the slide, bolt carrier group, and trigger mechanism.
-No Solid Particulates: Unlike many modern gun lubes that rely on suspended solids like Teflon (PTFE) or graphite, which can gum up or bake onto components over time, Vril contains no solid particulates, cleaning and lubricating in a single step.

Results proven by:
-Extreme Pressure & Load Testing (ASTM D2783 / D2596) AKA "4-ball testing"
-Coefficient of Friction & Wear (ASTM D4172 / D5182)
-Viscosity Index and Stability (ASTM D445)
-Extensive field testing over many years
